_comment: exp/nextgen-fin Grid A sweep 2. s1 showed the MID pad is a huge flex lever (+~10 N per UD pair) so no s1 design hit ~13.5 N with a MID kick. s2 thins the through-section hard (skins-only up to skins + 1 UD core pair + 1 mid UD) and uses the lightest MID pads twill can give (twill@45 or twill@0 pair). NO BIAX -- torsional +-45 from twill_3k_198 @ 45 only.
_targets: flex W(90) ~13.5 N (baseline 15.52 - 2), kick MID f~0.46, k_twist > 16249 N.mm/rad at a matched theta_at_probe (baseline 118.3 deg).
